title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.4 — Runes of Aldur, Bosses, Items and Build Impact
summary: A player-impact breakdown of 0.5.4: Expedition Atlas, Liquid Verisium, Orb of Sacrifice, level-scaling Unique skills, Pinnacle Boss changes, and the 0.5.4b/0.5.4e follow-ups.
description: Not an official patch mirror. 0.5.4 is reorganised by player task: what changes immediately, which Guides need a re-check, the Hotfix timeline, and which community issues are still open.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: A storm-darkened ruined city representing the 0.5.4 Runes of Aldur update

versions.summary: Runes of Aldur, Expedition Atlas Passive Tree, Liquid Verisium, Orb of Sacrifice, level-scaling Unique skills and Pinnacle Boss changes.
Merchant Stash item loss, Liquid Verisium stack purchase, and several Expedition Atlas behaviour fixes.
Boss readability pass (Arbiter, Vessel of Kulemak), Expedition invisible/invincible/out-of-bounds and underground fixes.
Migrate All now moves Ritual Offered Tribute and Breach League resources and tree unlocks.
Fixed Oath Rune sometimes spawning an invincible monster. Must be recorded separately from the 0.5.4d migration notes.
Shader loading improvements, disabled Steam Vulkan Fossilize layer, and default VSync changed to Capped.

cards.detail: A new Expedition Atlas Passive Tree plus reworked Grand Expedition and Remnant behaviour. This affects Atlas routing and farming Guides, not every Campaign Expedition.
Equipment-granted skills now scale by requirement tier. Builds that depend on those Uniques are the most exposed; ordinary Ice Shot / ED Builds are not.
Arbiter, Vessel of Kulemak and others were adjusted across 0.5.4 and 0.5.4b. Old phase or window descriptions may be stale.
Liquid Verisium, four Orb of Sacrifice variants and The Master's Reach enter the content library and need their own pages.

sections.title: Official changes, reorganised by player problem

changes.title: Expedition Atlas Passive Tree
changes.detail: Granted by the Grand Expedition questline Boss. It affects Atlas routes, unlock Guides and farming content, not all Campaign Expeditions.

changes.title: Liquid Verisium and Orb of Sacrifice
changes.detail: Liquid Verisium starts a Remnant Encounter with a random Runic Inscription. Orb of Sacrifice upgrades a corrupted enchant and sacrifices a random explicit modifier.

changes.title: Pinnacle Boss resistances and danger windows
changes.detail: 0.5.4 lowered some Boss resistances; 0.5.4b further improved Arbiter and Vessel of Kulemak telegraphs and windows.

changes.title: Currency / Fragment stack totals
changes.detail: Hold Alt to see the combined total across Inventory and Trade Window. A UI behaviour update, not a mechanical change.

changes.title: Runes, Atlas Passive and Expedition bug fixes
changes.detail: Several issues were fixed again in 0.5.4b and the d Hotfix, so related Guides cannot be marked against 0.5.4 alone.

sections.title: Expedition: four things to re-check
sections.oldText: Routes written only for 0.5.0 or 0.5.4 day-one may miss the new Atlas, Boss health corrections, underground fixes and the Hotfix chain.
sections.newText: State the specific conclusion's version (0.5.4, 0.5.4b or a later Hotfix) directly in the body, and link the Expedition Guide status.

bosses.name: Arbiter of Ash
bosses.detail: 0.5.4 adjusted Sphere buffs; 0.5.4b extended Flame Seed reaction time and added earlier voice cues.
bosses.action: Re-cut video timestamps and attack table

bosses.name: Arbiter of Divinity
bosses.detail: Orb of Divinity visual timing improved; later fixes addressed loot position, exit and phase cues.

bosses.name: Vessel of Kulemak
bosses.detail: Burning Ground adjusted, then final-phase summon, portal visuals and attack windows changed again.

items.title: Liquid Verisium
items.detail: Immediately starts a Remnant Encounter with a random Runic Inscription. Acquisition and use depend on Expedition Atlas conditions.

items.title: Orb of Sacrifice (x4)
items.detail: Drops from Atziri's Temple; upgrades the corrupted enchant of a matching item type while removing a random explicit modifier.

items.title: Skill-granting Uniques
items.detail: Equipment-granted skills use the lowest skill level the character currently meets, then scale up to the stated cap as requirements are satisfied.

items.title: The Master's Reach
items.detail: New Unique from a fully Empowered Vessel of Kulemak. Build adoption needs a separate Item and Build verification.

reports.quote: Shader count dropped noticeably, but results still vary by hardware.
reports.analysis: The body must split by renderer, platform and first-vs-repeat run; it cannot say '0.5.4e fully fixed stutter'.

reports.quote: Can Oath Rune still spawn an impossible encounter?
reports.analysis: The Hotfix page must show the problem-to-fix chain, not just quote the two 0.5.4d migration lines.
